Addendum No. 1 — Bid NB-IT-2026-014
Addendum No. 1 modifies the original solicitation.
DEADLINE CHANGE: The electronic bid submission deadline is extended from November 18, 2026 at 2:00 PM
EST to November 25, 2026 at 2:00 PM EST.
DELIVERY CHANGE: The required delivery period is changed from 60 calendar days to 75 calendar days after
purchase order issuance.
SPECIFICATION CLARIFICATION: The firewall security subscription must cover three years from the date of
activation.
All other requirements of the original RFP remain unchanged.

City of Northbridge — Municipal Network Equipment RFP
Bid Number: NB-IT-2026-014
Title: Municipal Network Equipment Refresh
Issuing Organization: City of Northbridge Department of Information Technology
Contract term: three years from contract execution, with one optional one-year renewal.
Bid bond: 5% of the total proposal amount is required.
Payment terms: Net 30 days after receipt and acceptance of an undisputed invoice.
Delivery: equipment must be delivered within 60 calendar days after purchase order issuance.
Required documentation: signed bid form, W-9, manufacturer authorization letter, and non-collusion affidavit.
All equipment must be new, unused, and covered by the manufacturer's standard warranty.

Technical Specifications — Municipal Network Equipment
Minimum technical requirements apply to the proposed equipment.
Network Switch: 48 x 1GbE copper ports, minimum 4 x 10GbE SFP+ uplinks, Layer 3 routing, VLAN support, IPv6
support, and centralized management.
Wireless Access Point: Wi-Fi 6E, 2.5GbE Ethernet uplink, WPA3 support, and centralized cloud management.
Firewall Appliance: minimum 8 x 1GbE interfaces, stateful inspection, IPS/IDS, VPN support, and a three-year
security subscription.
Manufacturer registration is required for all network equipment before deployment.
Proposed manufacturer: NetAxis Systems.

Vendor Compliance and Affidavit Requirements
Bid Number: NB-IT-2026-014
The following documents must accompany the submitted proposal: signed bid form, W-9, manufacturer
authorization letter, and non-collusion affidavit.
The bidder shall certify that the proposal has not been prepared through collusion with another bidder.
The manufacturer authorization letter must confirm that the bidder is authorized to sell and support the proposed
NetAxis Systems equipment.
Failure to provide a required document may result in the proposal being deemed non-responsive.
